Homeward Selves.name: Homeward Selves
Homeward Selves.description: The user sends doubles out to scout, search or listen, and each one carries what it learns home. The moment a double bursts or touches the user again, its memories flow back into the user: every room it saw, every word it heard, every face and every trap, so a whole building can be scouted in seconds from outside it. The bursts come back with the memories: the user feels each double's last moment, and after taking more than a handful back they are dazed until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
